newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso recovers as U.S financial mkts improve.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso recovers as U.S financial mkts improve.

text.p: The Mexican peso recovered at the open on Friday after stumbling Thursday as the mood on U.S. financial markets improved, traders said.
"The forex market seems calmer than yesterday," said a trader. "The peso will be firm so long as Wall Street stays ahead and long bond rates stay put."
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart opened two and 1.2 centavos firmer respectively, at 7.8750/7.8790 and 7.8690/7.8740 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts meanwhile opened up 2.6 centavos firmer at 7.8570/7.8630 per dollar.
The Dow Jones was up 51 points at 6,494.68 points, while yields on U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were down to 6.72 percent, from 6.74 percent in late trade on Thursday.
"The peso is recovering as it had no reason to slide yesterday. Dealers were just speculating on the Dow Jones and the U.S. long bond," another dealers said.
Dealers forecast a trading range of 7.8750/7.9000 per dollar for the 48-hour peso.
